method: Targeted reading of abstracts, introductions and relevant documentation sections. Not a claim to have watched every video frame or reproduced complete research algorithms.

sources.title: Procedural Modeling of Cities — Parish & Müller
sources.finding: City generation separates the street network, lots and buildings.
sources.decision: Use one coherent road, building parcels and waterfront boundary; do not scatter unrelated buildings.
sources.status: Applied to layout; no L-system city solver implemented

sources.title: Instant Architecture — Wonka et al.
sources.finding: Split grammars organize buildings through parameterized subdivisions and matching attributes.
sources.decision: Divide each facade into storeys and bays, then instantiate piers, lintels and openings with explicit dimensions.
sources.status: Applied as a small deterministic module system; not the full paper algorithm

sources.title: Procedural Modeling of Buildings — Müller et al.
sources.finding: Hierarchical building rules and context constraints coordinate massing and facade details.
sources.decision: Place entrances at pavement level, preserve real openings, connect balcony slabs and rails, and build parapets around roofs.
sources.status: Applied to architecture

sources.title: Image-based Procedural Modeling of Facades — Müller et al.
sources.finding: Facade structure can be represented through a semantic hierarchy of floors, tiles and details.
sources.decision: Use consistent window rhythm with controlled curtain and shop variations.
sources.status: Hierarchy applied; no photo reconstruction or automatic facade inference claimed

sources.title: Interactive Procedural Street Modeling — Chen et al.
sources.finding: Street design can incorporate boundaries, terrain and local editing constraints.
sources.decision: Constrain streets and parcels to the shoreline; keep the promenade continuous.
sources.status: Layout principle applied; no tensor-field street solver implemented

sources.title: Physically-Based Shading at Disney — Burley
sources.finding: Physically based shading connects material parameters to measured surface behavior.
sources.decision: Separate dielectric plaster, glass and masonry from exposed metal; vary roughness and normals instead of adding arbitrary geometry.
sources.status: Applied using standard glTF PBR materials, not a custom Disney BRDF

sources.title: Moving Frostbite to Physically Based Rendering — Lagarde & de Rousiers
sources.finding: Material authoring, lighting, exposure and validation belong to one consistent rendering workflow.
sources.decision: Use separate color and linear data maps, shared exposure, and directional sun with cool ambient light.
sources.status: Author overview reviewed; asset/preview workflow applied. Full 54 MB course PDF was not read end to end

sources.title: URP Lit shader material Inspector
sources.finding: Lit supports opaque and transparent surfaces plus metallic/specular workflows; unused variants add rendering cost.
sources.decision: Use shared PBR surfaces and transparent recessed glazing; later map these to URP Lit.
sources.status: glTF materials applied; URP material import not yet verified

sources.title: Normal maps
sources.finding: Normal maps add lighting detail to surface shading without changing the silhouette.
sources.decision: Use CC0 plaster, brick, concrete and paving normal maps at consistent metre scale.
sources.status: Applied to exported material maps; Unity normal texture import pending

sources.title: Occlusion maps
sources.finding: Occlusion maps attenuate indirect lighting and reflections, rather than replacing direct-light shadows.
sources.decision: Keep direct shadows separate; do not bake black grime over every surface.
sources.status: Design constraint applied; unique baked AO maps not generated

sources.title: Metallic and specular values of real surfaces
sources.finding: Material charts distinguish metallic reflectance from dielectric behavior.
sources.decision: Set masonry/plaster/glass metalness to zero; use high metalness only for exposed metal.
sources.status: Applied to material definitions

sources.title: Reflection Probes
sources.finding: Probes capture surrounding environments and can blend between different reflection regions.
sources.decision: Plan separate baked probes for the street, lobby and waterfront; browser inspection uses an approximate environment.
sources.status: Unity configuration pending Editor verification

sources.title: Adaptive Probe Volumes in URP
sources.finding: APV automates probe placement and supplies per-pixel indirect lighting.
sources.decision: Plan denser probes near entrances and underneath balconies for moving characters.
sources.status: Unity configuration pending Editor verification

sources.title: LOD Group component
sources.finding: LOD Groups choose mesh detail levels and optionally cross-fade transitions.
sources.decision: Export distinct LOD1 building meshes; retain major silhouettes while dropping interior and small roof detail.
sources.status: Reduced meshes exported; Unity LODGroup wiring and thresholds pending

sources.title: Occlusion culling
sources.finding: Occlusion culling excludes renderers completely hidden behind other geometry.
sources.decision: Keep buildings and facade floors as separate chunks rather than merging the entire city into one renderer.
sources.status: Chunk structure exported; Unity occlusion bake pending

sources.title: Set up scene and lights for baking
sources.finding: Static light baking needs suitable meshes, UVs and lighting settings; moving objects need indirect-light support.
sources.decision: Plan static GI for architecture and APV for characters in URP. Do not use the page’s legacy LPPV instructions for this URP project.
sources.status: Unity configuration pending Editor verification

sources.title: Generate lightmap UVs
sources.finding: Lightmap UVs need non-overlapping charts and padding, separately from tiled surface UVs.
sources.decision: Keep metre-scaled tiled material UVs now; generate a separate secondary UV set in the Unity import pass.
sources.status: Surface UVs applied; secondary lightmap unwrap pending

sources.title: Screen Space Ambient Occlusion in URP
sources.finding: SSAO is a renderer feature using scene depth or normals; it is separate from Volume effects.
sources.decision: Plan modest SSAO for contacts and recesses, tested against a disabled baseline.
sources.status: Unity configuration pending Editor verification

sources.title: Shadow cascades
sources.finding: Directional shadow cascades distribute shadow resolution over camera distance.
sources.decision: Start with two cascades, 60 m shadow distance and 2048 atlas; profile before increasing. CPU previews use their own shadow map.
sources.status: Unity configuration pending Editor verification

sources.title: Tonemapping Volume Override in URP
sources.finding: ACES and Neutral provide different highlight roll-off and color treatment.
sources.decision: Use restrained ACES in inspection and compare with Neutral later in Unity.
sources.status: Browser/CPU preview tonemapping applied; Unity Volume pending

sources.title: Scriptable Render Pipeline Batcher in URP
sources.finding: SRP Batcher reduces CPU material-state preparation for compatible shader variants.
sources.decision: Reuse a small shared material set; avoid unnecessary shader variants.
sources.status: Shared material design applied; Unity profiler verification pending

sources.title: Introduction to GPU instancing
sources.finding: Instancing can draw repeated compatible mesh/material pairs; benefits depend on platform and render path.
sources.decision: Keep repeated palm/prop sources reusable. Measure SRP batching versus instancing rather than enabling both indiscriminately.
sources.status: Prototype geometry exported; instanced Unity renderers pending

sources.title: Enable GPU Resident Drawer in URP
sources.finding: GPU Resident Drawer uses BatchRendererGroup and has render-path and renderer compatibility requirements.
sources.decision: Evaluate only after an ordinary URP baseline runs. No performance claim from triangle count alone.
sources.status: Unity configuration pending Editor verification

sources.title: Optimizing texture memory with mipmap streaming
sources.finding: Mipmap streaming manages GPU texture residency under a configurable budget.
sources.decision: Use shared 1K color maps and 512 data maps for this pass; later test a 256 MB streaming budget.
sources.status: Asset texture sizing applied; Unity streaming configuration pending

sources.title: Introduction to decals in URP
sources.finding: URP decals project materials onto opaque geometry; atlases can reduce material cost.
sources.decision: Export markings and drain details as thin meshes now. Use a later atlas/projector pass for localized stains; transparent glass does not receive decals.
sources.status: Thin marking meshes applied; Decal Renderer Feature pending
